name: _cast_Half
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI): aten::_cast_Half(Tensor self, bool non_blocking=False) -> Tensor. This representative signature is not exclusive: the original Gems pytest owns the full contract for overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation, and no test may be narrowed, removed, or have reference behavior adapted to fit this one signature. Registered schemas supplied verbatim: aten::_cast_Half(Tensor self, bool non_blocking=False) -> Tensor. Semantics: a unary narrowing cast of every element of self to float16 (round-to-nearest-even, subnormals included), where out-of-range magnitudes become +/-Inf; integer (int8, uint8, int32, int64), bool, float8_e4m3fn, float8_e5m2, float16, bfloat16, float32, float64, complex64 and complex128 inputs are accepted, with any imaginary part discarded. Non_blocking defaults to false and may be passed positionally or by keyword. For a float16 self, the native operator returns the input object itself (object identity) for dense, transposed, offset, holed-stride, 0-dim and empty inputs; callers must not treat this as a generally guaranteed alias since it is conditional on the input dtype. The operator is unary, so no broadcast dimension applies, and there is no .out overload (torch.ops.aten._cast_Half.out raises AttributeError), so no out= workload exists. It rejects non-tensor input, a missing input, and a string non_blocking value; non-bool values such as None or 1 are coerced by the native binding rather than rejected. Backward converts the upstream float16 gradient back to the input dtype. The schema default for non_blocking is the JSON boolean false (a native bool default, not a rendered non-JSON default).
